Medicare Part A.typical_fit_note: Generally workable for short-stay skilled rehab when skilled need is documented.

Medicare Advantage.typical_fit_note: Often requires plan authorization before admission; missing auth creates delay risk.

Medicaid.typical_fit_note: Common for long-term care but may have lower reimbursement and network constraints.

Commercial.typical_fit_note: Can be attractive when in-network and authorized; admin burden can be high.

Private Pay.typical_fit_note: Often relevant for assisted living or respite care; requires deposit/financial confirmation.

Out of Network Managed Medicaid.typical_fit_note: Usually not workable unless special agreement exists.
